checks.name: Every V20 source is unchanged or preserved with original geometry and materials
Replacement originals are isolated and hidden
All ten surface islands and three underground islands receive native detail
Waiting-room side passages have existing deck support and 2.1 m headroom
All thirty existing surface stair apertures stay clear
New structures clear model train-body and upper electrical corridors
Actual roof meshes and frames leave the inherited OCS mast shafts open
Relocated rooftop rooms and support pedestals clear actual OCS meshes
All Metro status lamps attach to the existing door-post tops
Finite native geometry and resolving image resources

limits: Dated street views and photographs inform visual structure; dimensions, repeated fittings and positions are estimates. These geometric model checks are not a survey or railway operational certification.
